A crown of tiny flowers, moss, and tangled stems rests upon her bowed head as she gazes peacefully toward a small curled leaf held in one hand like a miniature cup. Golden specks of light drift from the vessel and shimmer around her fingers. Above and behind her, the oversized flower curves protectively through the scene, its pink petals covered with beads of moisture. Slender twisting stems rise throughout the composition, each tipped with suspended droplets that catch the light. The softly blurred background of pale stone and muted foliage creates a dreamy sense of scale, making the fairy appear hidden within a secret garden world revealed just after the rain.
